trailer27d: Our new year began on the first of October, and the first class of it is being selected now. Seven places. Not because we can't take more, but because every one of them gets the full build: a call within forty-eight hours, the Branch Manager himself, an orientation, a profile, and a Discovery with the people already doing it. And one more seat: for a sales manager, to build a unit here. Thirty-two years in Trinidad. One class. Seven places.
